historical_reviews.deepseek: Correct general subsystem but weak endpoint trust, response selection and secret handling can falsely associate another firmware entry.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds exact RMI member, component uniqueness, TLS chain, credential broker, release mapping and no-update boundary.

historical_reviews.v3_1: Retains the RMI firmware identity independently of the transport used to query it.

original_test_intent: Confirm the active remote-management interface firmware on the intended GPU management subsystem is the release-approved version.
original_method: Use a verified read-only Redfish session to retrieve exact rmi_active, bind its component/active status to the intended management interface and compare its redacted version evidence against the approved release entry.
manual_activity: Management-firmware/security engineers approve RMI identity/access and release target, resolve discrepancies and own the verdict.
required_inputs: Verified BMC service/certificate and ACL path
Expected active RMI version and authoritative release note
safety_requirements: Query only the precise inventory member at least privilege
Require one unambiguous active RMI component
Never expose secrets or invoke firmware changes
agent_execution_scope: Perform the authorized exact RMI GET
Compare active RMI version to supplied baseline
Do not disable trust, enumerate mutation paths or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve trust/access and RMI component mapping
Resolve mismatch/security/schema issues and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Broad insecure inventory access cannot prove that a selected value is rmi_active and leaks credentials.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Read exact rmi_active through verified HTTPS with brokered read-only credentials and compare its unique active version to the approved release.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Remote-management active firmware scope, release comparison and source 5/5 timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record verified service identity, rmi_active URI/component/active state/version, expected release and redacted access audit in one trace.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Secures the lookup and eliminates other-component ambiguity.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Retimer, bundle and SMC records cannot substitute for RMI.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: RMI terminology may be vendor-specific; the project schema map must define the physical/logical component.

project_override_considerations: A secure vendor management query is acceptable only if it uniquely reports the same active RMI firmware and release mapping; updates are excluded.
expected_evidence: Exact rmi_active URI/status/timestamp and redacted fields
BMC audit/security notes and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and rmi_active URI consistently target active remote-management firmware; schema mapping is a prerequisite, not a conflicting source.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Trust, access, schema and release value can be supplied; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Converts a broad trust-disabled inventory read into a component-specific, secure and release-traceable RMI active-version assertion.
independent_technical_reasoning: Remote-management firmware is itself part of the evidence/control plane, so querying the wrong manager or accepting an unverified certificate can fabricate a convincing version. Exact member identity, active state and trusted transport are therefore integral to the firmware comparison, not ancillary security checks.
